reason: Value/transfer lens: the realistic public gain is about +0.0003 (range -0.003..+0.002), so it misses the +0.002 bar. The selection it adds is driven entirely by the in-sample edge network, so the lab cannot validate it. Checked facts: (a) tracksdata ILPSolver has node_weight (default 0.0) and pairwise overlap constraints x_i+x_j<=1 (raw _ilp_solver.py, 436 lines; the overlaps apply only if graph.has_overlaps()). Our call passes no node weight (predict_unet_transformer.py l.560-568). (b) The premise that threshold lowering 'had no selection' is wrong. In exp56 cell 0 the ILP runs with appearance 0, disappearance 2, division 1.2 and edge cost -1*edge_prob. So it already selects nodes by temporal consistency at ZERO node cost: extending a track end costs -p (free), and a new track pays 2 - sum(p). Probe 4 (det 0.965->0.95, CONTEXT.md l.158) sent the extra sliver through exactly this selection, with a laxer rule than the proposal, and scored 0.940, neutral. The idea's cost hyp=beta*(logit .965 - logit s) against p<=1 per edge acts as an edge-supported threshold at s ~0.944 (beta 2), ~0.91 (beta 1) or ~0.79 (beta 0.5). Beta 2 reproduces probe 4. Beta 0.5-1 reaches deeper into the band, where public evidence puts the value density at <=0: det 0.99 -0.005 shows value above 0.965; 0.95 is flat; gapfill on 0.5 peaks gave 0.947->0.947; readmit gave ->0.946; MIN_TRACK_LEN 4 gave -0.002. (c) Ceiling recomputed: a_never 1907 + a_tail 606 = 2513 FN = +0.0185 local (fn_anatomy_exp39.md, pooled 1/135,729 per FN->TP). The ILP contributes only the node set, because the flow relink rebuilds the edges. Capture chain, all guesses: pool-hit 0.3-0.5 x ILP-selected 0.4-0.6 x kept by relink/tail with the right link 0.6 x not already taken by x138 readmit/gapfill 0.6-0.7 = 4-13% -> 110-320 FN->TP = +0.0008..+0.0024 local gross. (d) Node cost. Temporal consistency selects REAL nuclei, not ANNOTATED ones. Annotated node recall is already 0.983 in-sample, while unannotated nuclei are weakly suppressed in training (w_neg=0.1/n_neg), so most consistent band tracks are unannotated real cells (6bba 13-15% annotated, 44b6 0.2-1.3%). Each +1% nodes = -0.0009 (break-even 122 FN->TP on the lab). A plausible +1..3% nodes costs -0.0009..-0.0027, and 44b6-like dense private embryos grow more. Net local ~-0.002..+0.0015. (e) Global input shift. The edge activation is softmax over sources (l.457) plus the bidirectional harmonic fusion. Appending band peaks redistributes probability away from EVERY standard edge near them. Band maxima can sit 3.25 um from standard peaks (3x3x3 pool window), so each can form a parallel duplicate track at p~0.5/0.5. Standard tracks whose sum(p) falls below the disappearance cost of 2 are then dropped: a regression on nodes that are fine today, and nobody measures it. The idea's change adds no overlap constraints. (f) Transfer. Selection = edge_prob, and that network was trained on all 199 train videos. The lab measured +0.01..+0.016 for network-trusting rules that gave 0 on the LB (#29/#30), so a lab gain here is discounted to ~0. The 44b6 confirmation is 18 crops of one recording, so it is not independent. The band pool is unrefined int16 (V1284 head not applied), and there is no train lowdet dump, so the lab needs a new GPU pass (6 GPU-h, competing with H1). (g) Measurement: LB sd ~0.003 (identical notebooks 0.946/0.942). A true +0.001 is invisible, and an adopt-at->=+0.002 rule fires on noise ~25% of the time. (h) Private risk: more ILP variables with superlinear SCIP time near ILP_TIMEOUT 1200 s. Late movies can cross REPAIR_DEADLINE_S 27000 and lose relink/gap/safe-div entirely, so the downside is concentrated on unseen, possibly denser embryos.
fix_if_any: Only a much narrower rider survives the lens, and it is then essentially byteext arm (a), already valued at <= +0.0012. (1) Kill test first (H1 step 0, CPU, exp56 dummy-clip outputs): share of a_never/FN GT nodes with a free band peak >= 0.5 within 3 um. Drop the idea if < 20%. (2) Never feed band peaks to the edge transformer, so the standard softmax/harmonic probabilities and the standard ILP stay byte-identical. Score band-peak candidate edges geometrically: flow-prior motion distance -> pseudo-prob exp(-d^2/2*2.5^2), no network confidence. Solve a second, small ILP (or a greedy pass) over the ORIGINAL ILP solution + band nodes, with every original node pinned to 1 (node_weight -inf). Band nodes then can only extend or bridge existing tracks, or form tracks >= 6 frames with hyp cost beta=1. (3) Add overlap constraints: band node vs any selected node within 4.5 um in the same frame (graph overlaps), so no parallel duplicates. (4) Hard cap +1% nodes per video (0.5% on 44b6-like density); log added nodes per video. (5) Refine band peaks with the V1284 head before insertion. (6) Gate: lab delta >= +0.001 on BOTH embryos with nodes <= +1%, ILP time +<= 10%, no video near the timeout. Then ride inside a finals variant that is submitted anyway; never spend a standalone LB slot on it, and never adopt on a single-probe delta < +0.003.
realistic_public_gain: +0.0003 central (range -0.003..+0.002); P(true gain >= +0.002) ~0.1. Anchors on the same public embryo: det 0.965->0.95 flat (same ILP selection, zero node cost), gapfill(0.5 pool) 0.000, readmit -0.001.
realistic_private_gain: 0.000 central (range -0.004..+0.002): the node multiplier and the ILP-runtime/REPAIR_DEADLINE risk grow on unseen and possibly denser embryos; the in-sample edge_prob selection does not transfer.
